notes: Historical initial-draft results at e937a6f. Upstream 1dc6fd0 adds a hosted registry default, so the missing-registry expectation and its comparative grade are obsolete for the current skill.
Three cases, one independent agent per case/configuration. Narrow smoke checks, not a statistically reliable comparison.
Execution token counts and durations were not exposed by agent completion notifications; no timing/cost metrics are reported.
Both publication agents recovered from an invalid output extension; this finding informed a targeted documentation fix.
Local SHACL verification blocked successful semantic checks. No live registry operations were attempted.
Checked-in evaluation prompts were subsequently translated into English. These historical runs predate that wording change; the translated prompts have not been rerun.
